content.title: Preformed Line: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: MAYFIELD VILLAGE, Ohio (AP) — Preformed Line Products Co. (PLPC) on Wednesday reported profit of $2.6 million in its third quarter. On a per-share basis, the Mayfield Village, Ohio-based company said it had net income of 53 cents. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs, were $2.09 per share.
